entries.note: Fischer 2017 (PMID 28549772) abstract quote verbatim; mouse RPGR expression/glutamylation readout has no sampled human counterpart, so untested/not_measured holds.
Song 2020 (PMID 32414297) quote verbatim; opsin relocalisation and transgene expression not measurable in treated patients; untested/not_measured correct.
Fischer 2017 abstract states no human dose, exposure or margin; untested/no_prediction holds (abstract only).
Song 2020 quote verbatim; Dufour 2020 abstract defines NOAEL 6x10^11 vg/mL. Opening untested entry at 2018 proxy is fine.

Yang 2024 (PMID 39643074) quote verbatim but is an efficacy sentence; human doses are vg/eye and HORIZON registry gives no vg/mL, so whether toxicity arose above the dog NOAEL concentration is unchecked. Dog toxic per-eye load (~2.1x10^11 vg) is below human tolerated 6.8x10^11 vg/eye.

entries.note: Fischer 2017 quote verbatim; opening untested entry for the mouse track.

Biogen 14 May 2021 release quote verbatim (via Firecrawl scrape); Lam 2024 Ophthalmology (PMID 38423215) 'primary microperimetry end point was not met' confirms; LUMEOS miss confirmed by Fierce/J&J 5 May 2025. Tier 1 record agrees, so status stands.
Dufour 2020 (PMID 31910043) quote verbatim; ERG/structure rescue at low/mid dose.
Beacon 21 Sep 2026 release quote verbatim; 31.0%/24.1% vs 0% at 6.8 and 3.7x10^11 vg/eye. Tier 5, trial_unreported correct; no registry results.
Fischer 2017 quote verbatim; mouse safety statement opens the track.

Cehajic-Kapetanovic 2020 (PMID 32094925) quote verbatim. Mice can show subretinal AAV inflammation, so silence scored contra is defensible; mouse vector loads unread, low confidence appropriate. Lam 2024 adds 7 vs 3 ocular SAEs high vs low dose.
Dufour 2020 quote verbatim; Song 2020 adds retinal detachment and inflammation at 3x10^12 vg/mL.

Yang 2024 quote verbatim; dose-limited posterior-segment/RPE toxicity at top dose matches dog high-dose toxicity in direction; lesion naming differs, as the draft says. VISTA (2026) reports no drug-related SAEs at 6.8x10^11.

Sladen 2024 (PMID 38339118, MDPI full text) quote verbatim. RPGR/opsin localisation has no human readout: untested/no_prediction holds. Vector was AAV7m8-hRKp.RPGR (bota-vec cassette, not its AAV5 capsid); product_in_model should be false.
Abstract sentence verbatim (epub 2 Feb 2024). Phase 1/2 primary was safety, so no retro score against it; opening untested entry stands. Capsid AAV7m8, not AAV5: product_in_model should be false.

MeiraGTx SEC EX-99.1 quote verbatim; VMA primary missed (J&J May 2025). Organoid paper (Feb 2024) predates readout, so prospective contra, year 2025, not retro. Sponsor blames maze insensitivity, not an untested condition.

missing: Botaretigene (bota-vec, AAV5-hRKp.RPGR) has no track although it is a class member with a phase 3 failure: human RPGR-KO iPSC retinal organoids tested the bota-vec clinical construct and said they 'support' the phase I/II results ahead of phase 3 (Sladen 2024, Int J Mol Sci, doi:10.3390/ijms25031839, PMID 38339118); LUMEOS then missed its primary (J&J 5 May 2025; Fierce Biotech). A prospective organoid efficacy entry would score contra in 2025 (engagement readout opsin localisation: not_measured).

Bota-vec phase 1/2 (Michaelides et al. 2024, AJO, doi:10.1016/j.ajo.2024.05.034, PMID 38871269): no dose-limiting events at 1-4x10^11 vg/mL and steroid-responsive ocular inflammation; patient-side data for a bota-vec preclinical track (its own mouse/dog/NHP basis not located).

XLPRA1/XLPRA2 dogs with AAV2/5-hIRBP/hGRK1-hRPGR (Beltran 2012 PNAS, doi:10.1073/pnas.1118847109, PMID 22308428): the original canine proof of concept for subretinal RPGR replacement; check whether it is bota-vec's preclinical basis (AAV5 capsid) and, if so, add it as a track.

Two 2026 meta-analyses of AAV-RPGR trials (J Transl Med doi:10.1186/s12967-026-08709-7; J Clin Med doi:10.3390/jcm15166144) are tier 4 patient-side sources the draft could cite for safety/efficacy pooling.
rule_questions: Dose entry 3 and safety entry 4 score the same dog-predicted top-dose retinal toxicity twice (dose same with margin_stated, safety same). 'Count the harm once' names only the misplaced-margin and unpredicted cases; does a correctly placed, predicted harm belong in dose, safety, or both?
Can a margin stated in vg/mL (dog) be scored against human doses reported only in vg/eye when injection volume is unknown, or must the dose entry stay untested?

Efficacy entry 2 uses the tier 5 press release as src while a tier 1 record (Lam 2024) of the same trial exists with the same status; should src move to the tier 1 record with year kept at the 2021 public date?

RPGR organoid track: the organoids carried the bota-vec hRKp.RPGR cassette in an AAV7m8 capsid, not the clinical AAV5. Does a same-cassette, different-capsid vector count as product_in_model true, or as a sibling drug (false)?

LUMEOS: the sponsor says the VMA maze 'was not sensitive enough' and a secondary PRO improved. Does blaming the endpoint's sensitivity fall under 'attributes the result to conditions the model never tested' (untested), or does a primary miss stay contra?
